G1b is the SAME-INFORMATION estimate (public features only) of the single-deviation-from-D policy class; its episode gain equals the true branched advantage at the first firing sampled point.
Abstain is its own class everywhere and never pooled into G1/G1b (reported separately).
Per-state headroom is never summed along trajectories.
